text: Starting this thread because we're shopping for scheduling apps. Firelane wants $79/mo and we're 25 people. Bisqueline charges per head. Anyone found something a small co-op can afford?
We use Bisqueline for booking wheels but the firing calendar is just a calendar. Doesn't tell you if the kiln has room, so people still show up with work and get turned away.
Whiteboard, honestly. We tried app alerts and they went out after the tech loaded because that's when she has time to type it in. Members got mad.
Our members' number one question is 'did my stuff get fired'. No app we've tried answers that without the manager logging every piece, which nobody does.
Replying to myself: Bisqueline quoted us $60 minimum, so that's $60 for 25 people either way. Still a lot for a volunteer-run studio.
Same as Sara. The calendar shows the firing, not the capacity. I'd pay for 'there are 2 shelves left'.
Manager here. Honestly members don't read the app OR the board. I text the regulars myself. The tool isn't the problem, attention is.
Firelane texts arrive after loading at our place too. It's not the app, it's when the manager posts. But the app should stop you posting a firing that's already happened.
Second the capacity thing. Booking a shelf that turns out not to exist is worse than no booking.
The status problem is real. 'Loaded' then nothing. I still walk over to check the shelf.
We turned notifications off after too many came the morning after. Now we're back to the group chat.
Price is the blocker for us. Two tiers and the cheap one doesn't do texts.
Anyone tried just a shared Google Calendar? Free, and members already have it.
Google Cal works until someone needs to reserve space. Then you're back to paying, and the per-member ones get expensive fast.
